defects.title: Deadlock condition encountered under 50 simultaneous debit calls
defects.steps: 1. Initialize account with $10,000 balance\n2. Trigger 50 asynchronous debit requests of $100 within a 20ms window\n3. Observe database connection pool exhaustion and transaction lock table
defects.expected_result: All 50 requests serialize cleanly via optimistic row locking without timeout
defects.actual_result: 3 out of 50 threads aborted with SQL Deadlock Error 1205
defects.root_cause: Missing clustered index hint in transaction update query, causing range lock escalation

defects.title: Webhook payload missing timestamp ISO-8601 millisecond precision
defects.steps: 1. Dispatch settlement confirmation webhook event\n2. Inspect delivered JSON payload headers and body\n3. Compare 'event_timestamp' format against API spec schema
defects.root_cause: Serialization formatter in event dispatch worker drops sub-second fractions
